rapport_notes: Professional and patient, but mechanical; minimal warmth or personality, mostly transactional data collection.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'do we have any specific concerns' late in discovery (after name/contact/source), not immediately after the quid pro quo framing.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let's start with a few questions to get you under white track this should take ten minutes of your time so that you can be able to build an accurate quote.
evidence_quotes.agenda: Do we have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to address during this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern: 'I just wanna make sure that I have enough time to let them out for we're getting out first so I have to make sure that I have enough time. So I just wanna make sure it's like, four hours at least.' Rep response: 'Okay.' Then immediately pivoted to 'can I have your first location address?' — no real follow-up or second-layer probe.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We will provide up to 2000 dollars from you that is to repair replace and reimburse for your items.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: A few days before your move we will be sending out emails letting you know who will be your movers are in that way it will help east attention of strangers arriving at the front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: A few days before your move we will be sending out emails letting you know who will be your movers are.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: We'll send out two movers to send one truck estimated time is five to six hours, in case they end up six hours that would be $1,332.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: We're timely based so in case they end up lesson that would be okay, you only need to pay for the actual hours anyway.
evidence_quotes.estimate_window: Whatever it is that we have and we can be able to book her status early as 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM... there's no deposit required, no recent securing your spot.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: Your rate locks when you book (implied in confirmation/no-deposit language).
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Would you like me to lock that in for you? — this is a yes/no question asked after the customer had already indicated readiness ('I'm locked in. Yeah, yeah, definitely'), not a clear forward-facing close ask.

top_strength: Zhang executed a clean quid pro quo framing upfront and asked the agenda question before diving into logistics, setting good discovery structure; also delivered all four differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Communication) in the correct Stage 2 slot without repetition.
coaching_note: When the customer raises a concern—especially one as specific as 'I need to make sure I have at least four hours'—dig two layers deep with real follow-up questions ('Tell me more about that dock time constraint' / 'What happens if we run over?') rather than acknowledging it with 'Okay' and moving on; this is the dominant failure mode and costs you real trust and problem-solving clarity.
